capabilities: List the current note's tasks in document order
Filter tasks by incomplete, completed or all
Jump to a task's line without moving the cursor
Reveal a task's parent heading breadcrumb on double-click
Show the note's heading tree with tasks nested underneath
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide task manager; it lists only the tasks in the note you are currently reading.
extras: Runs fully locally with no network requests or telemetry; settings and first-seen task timestamps are stored in the plugin's data.json. Interface follows the Obsidian app language, with English and Chinese built in. README notes the plugin is pending approval in the Community Plugins directory.
motivation: Long notes accumulate tasks across many sections, so the author wanted a lightweight per-note checklist in the right sidebar instead of scrolling or setting up heavy vault-wide queries.
problem: Tasks scattered through a long note are hard to review without scrolling the whole file or building vault-wide queries.

relations.evidence: If the line already has a date (➕ YYYY-MM-DD from Tasks
created:: YYYY-MM-DD from Dataview), that date is shown

summary: Sidebar panel that lists the current note's Markdown tasks in order, with status filters, breadcrumbs and click-to-jump navigation.
